instruction.text: There are lots of different types of algorithms that we follow in everyday life. Select all the examples of algorithms.

hint.text: An algorithm is a list of instructions that must be followed in the right order.
hint.label: Algorithm

feedback.end: Computers also follow a special type of algorithm called a program. Programs tell computers what to do.

atoms.text: Alex has now returned home from school. His class have been given sunflower seeds to plant at home.

instruction.text: To plant and grow the sunflower correctly, Alex will need to follow some instructions. Sort the steps into the correct order.

atoms.sound: Fill the plant pot with soil.
Plant the seed in the soil.

instruction.text: What would happen if Alex completed the instructions in the wrong order? Select the sunflower to find out.

text: The sunflower would wither and die or not grow at all!

atoms.text: Alex would now like to bake a cake for his mum’s birthday tomorrow.

instruction.text: Sort the steps of the recipe for Alex’s cake into the correct order.

atoms.sound: Put the cake in the oven.

instruction.text: What would happen if Alex completed the recipe in the wrong order? Select the cake to find out.

text: There would be a big mess or the cake might not even be baked at all!

atoms.text: Now Alex wants to go to the park. The blue arrows on this map show the route he must take to get there.

instruction.text: Use the map to sort the directions into the correct order to take Alex to the park.

atoms.text: Walk straight out of the house.
Walk straight along the long road.
Finally, walk straight until you reach the park.
